FX-CSTAB-001.says: The settings as added: brightness, reference frame 0, sample size 5. Frame 0 is the reference, so untouched; frame 1, the ramp lifted by 20, comes back to frame 0; frames 2 and 3 move by their black point's brightness only.

FX-CSTAB-002.says: Levels: each channel mapped through the black and white samples, so frame 2's colour cast and contrast are taken out, to the drawing's own rounding.

FX-CSTAB-003.says: Curves: through black, mid and white, so frame 3's raised mid-tones come down too.

FX-CSTAB-004.says: Levels with reference frame 2: frame 0, the plain ramp, is given frame 2's cast.

FX-CSTAB-005.says: Reference frame 2.7, taken down to 2: the same as FX-CSTAB-004.

FX-CSTAB-006.says: Sample size 0: each sample the one pixel holding its point.

FX-CSTAB-007.says: Sample size keyed from 1 at frame 0 to 9 at frame 4: the reference samples taken at size 1 as frame 0 has it, the current ones at 5 at frame 2 and 7 at frame 3.

FX-CSTAB-008.says: The black point at (10, 20) and the white point at (90, 80), levels: the white sample reaches the half-covered column, counted at half weight.

FX-CSTAB-009.says: The black point keyed from (25, 50) at frame 0 to (5, 50) at frame 4, levels: the reference sample is taken where the point is at frame 0, the current one where it is at frame 2.

FX-CSTAB-010.says: Reference frame 20, after the layer's last frame: no reference, so every frame as it is.

FX-CSTAB-011.says: A Levels lowering output white to 200, then the stabilizer, levels: the samples are of the darkened pictures, so frame 2 comes back to the darkened frame 0.

FX-CSTAB-012.says: On an adjustment layer above the holder: no reference frame, so each frame as it is, with a warning each frame.

FX-CSTAB-013.says: Stabilize "colour", which is not a choice. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CSTAB-014.says: Stabilize "Levels": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CSTAB-015.says: Reference frame -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-CSTAB-016.says: Sample size 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
